Growing twelve to fifteen meters in length, '''methnaps''' were used as mounts by the seagoing ranchers of [[Chad/Legends|Chad]]. They were akin to [[tsaelke]] and [[cy'een]]. They could carry up to 125 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="AJ10" />
